Chapter 198: Chapter 4: The Heiyu Family (Please Subscribe)_3

At first, Lin Yuan still managed to make time for a meeting.

He clearly expressed his attitude.

But in the end, the frequency was simply too high.

Lin Yuan simply stopped meeting with them, leaving it to the intelligent assistant to cope.

“If it had been announced initially that I had passed the Seven Star Cave test…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

...

If it were only like Fang Qing, merely passing the test and becoming an official member of the Red Kun Lineage,

perhaps these powers wouldn’t have invited him so insistently.

After all, as an official member of the Red Kun Lineage, where is the sense in working for other powers?

The Red Kun Lineage itself is the most powerful force.

However, doing so would require Lin Yuan to take a spaceship battleship to the Chikun Main Star with those like Fang Qing who had passed the test.

This was the normal procedure for each batch joining the Red Kun Lineage.

Lin Yuan was able to stay on Canglan Star all this time, entirely because he was the Peak Master of Shisan, enjoying many privileges; even the gift from the Chikun Star Lord had to be delivered through the express efforts of the “Shuntong” Group, costing hundreds of billions of civilization coins.

…

On this day.

Lin Yuan had just finished cultivating.

The voice of the intelligent assistant then came through.

“Master, the person who is visiting this time comes from the Heiyu Family, namely the subordinate of Heiyu Ao, who is the three thousand eight hundred and twenty-first son of Heiyu Mo.”

“The Heiyu Family?” Lin Yuan’s eyebrows slightly furrowed.

The Heiyu Family is a force within the Chikun Star Domain, ranking within the top five among the many powers beside the Red Kun Lineage.

The strongest of the Heiyu Family, Heiyu Mo, is an existence that surpasses the Sixth Rank.

“The Heiyu Family…” Lin Yuan pondered for a while.

“Let’s meet.”

He could ignore other powers and financial groups, partly because most of them are Sixth Rank forces,

and Lin Yuan, on the path to becoming a Sixth Rank Evolver, saw it only as a matter of time.

Secondly, most invitations were from groups from outside the Chikun Star Domain, with no need for excessive intimacy.

But the Heiyu Family was different. As a native force of the Chikun Star Domain, when Lin Yuan would step into Sixth Rank and reveal his identity, he might have to interact with them.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the Virtual World.

His personal space.

Lin Yuan agreed to enter.

An old man dressed in a black suit, as elegant as a nobleman, appeared before him.

“Bei Zhao, on behalf of my young master Heiyu Ao, greets Mr. Lin Yuan.”

The old man in the black suit, Bei Zhao, had a very low posture, and his tone was slightly respectful.

He then stated the terms for inviting Lin Yuan to join under Heiyu Ao.

“I’m not really interested in arena battles at the moment, sorry.”

Lin Yuan tried to soften his tone as he spoke.

“Is that so.”

The expression of the old man in the black suit, Bei Zhao, showed no change.

After standing up to take his leave, he disappeared on the spot.

“Quite reasonable?”

Lin Yuan slightly nodded.

The representatives of those powers who had invited him, upon being rejected, most would usually hint at or outright threaten him.

…

Inside a splendid palace.

Heiyu Ao was seated on the throne, deep in thought.

At that moment, the figure of the old man in the black suit, Bei Zhao, appeared.

“Which tier of contract did that Lin Yuan choose?” Heiyu Ao said casually.

Before sending Bei Zhao to invite Lin Yuan, Heiyu Ao had set five tiers of contracts.

The higher the tier of the contract, the more support for Lin Yuan and also the greater the restrictions.

He left it to Lin Yuan to choose any tier he desired.

“Young master.”

The old man in the black suit, Bei Zhao, bowed slightly.

“Lin Yuan has declined the young master’s invitation.”

The old man in the black suit said softly.

“He declined my invitation?”

On the throne, Heiyu Ao felt slightly taken aback.

He looked down at the old man in the black suit, Bei Zhao.
